name: application-reservation-time-picker
title: Reservation Time Picker
description: Party-size stepper, date trigger, and a wrapped grid of available/unavailable time chips with a confirm action, driven by a typed party-size/date/times prop contract.
useWhen: Booking a restaurant table or similar reservation where party size, date, and time slot all need to be chosen together.
Time slots should render as a compact wrapping chip grid rather than a full calendar grid.
Some time chips are unavailable and should remain visible but unselectable, distinct from selectable slots.
avoidWhen: You need a full week/day grid of bookable slots — use the Availability Grid instead.
There's no party-size concept (e.g. equipment or room booking) — a simpler Date Picker plus time chips without the stepper is enough.
Pricing varies by slot — use the Delivery Slot Picker pattern instead, which surfaces price per option.
responsiveBehavior: The party-size and date controls sit in a two-column grid that can stack on very narrow viewports; the time chip row wraps naturally via flex-wrap regardless of width.
accessibility: The party-size stepper buttons carry explicit aria-labels ('Decrease party size', 'Increase party size') since they show only a glyph.
Unavailable time chips are real disabled buttons, not just visually dimmed clickable elements, so they're correctly skipped in keyboard navigation.
The selected time chip uses aria-pressed in addition to its filled background, and the confirm button restates the full selection in its label.

variants.title: Reservation Time Picker
variants.description: Party-size stepper and date trigger side by side, a wrapping grid of available/unavailable/selected time chips, and a confirm button restating the full booking.
accessibility: Unavailable time chips are disabled buttons rather than styled spans, keeping them out of the tab order appropriately.

variants.title: Reservation Time Picker (Dark)
variants.description: Reservation picker adapted for dark surfaces with the same party-size, date, time-chip, and confirm-action structure.
accessibility: Time chip fills, ring colors, and the confirm button must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
